subject: WellScope: scheduling window blocked by procurement gating and exec travel
messages:
From: Emily Tan <e.tan@wellscopehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to pause live demo — procurement vendor onboarding + exec travel

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Quick update from our side — procurement flagged Redwood as a vendor that requires the full onboarding packet before any exec-facing live demos. Additionally, our Head of Product (David) will be travelling next week and unavailable for the window we had penciled in.

Procurement asked us to complete:
- Vendor onboarding form (attached)
- SSO & data-flow questionnaire (they sent a spreadsheet; see attached)
- NDA signed via Docusign (they prefer vendor-signed NDA before exec briefing)

If we don't complete those by the end of next week, procurement wants to push the demo until the attestation is on file. Given David's travel, can we:
1) Move the live exec demo to the week of Aug 9, or
2) Run a technical preview next week with our engineering leads (no execs), and record an exec-friendly version for later?

We can prioritize the onboarding forms but it may take time on our side. Attaching the vendor form and SSO requirements — procurement copied.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Tan
Director, Product Operations | WellScope Health
procurements@wellscopehealth.com

Attachments: wellscope_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (form), wellscope_ssoreqs.xlsx (procurement questionnaire)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Tan <e.tan@wellscopehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to pause live demo — procurement vendor onboarding + exec travel

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads-up and for sending the attachments. Totally understand procurement's gating.

Proposed plan (short):
- We'll complete and return the vendor onboarding form + a short attestation for procurement by Tue EOD 7/20.
- Ben will share a draft NDA (vendor-signed) via DocuSign today so procurement can review.
- If David is unavailable, we're happy to:
  • Do a technical run for engineers next week (45–60m), or
  • Record an exec-focused demo that you can circulate.

Can Marissa confirm which Redwood technical leads should be on the engineer-run? I recommend: Marissa (solutions), Ben (AE, product fit), and me (platform + deployment notes).

If you prefer we open a short mutual action plan, I added a Calendly poll link to propose candidate dates: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-poll-WSH — feel free to pick slots or we can anchor Aug 9–13 for an exec window.

I attached our security packet (redwood_security_packet_v2.pdf) — that should answer many of the SSO / data-flow questions; if procurement needs a formal attestation page, Marissa and I can sign.

We want to avoid double work on your side — let me know which approach works and we'll prioritize the NDA + onboarding form.

Best,
Logan Wright
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: redwood_security_packet_v2.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Tan <e.tan@wellscopehealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to pause live demo — procurement vendor onboarding + exec travel

Emily — looping a couple operational notes from our side so procurement has what they need quickly.

Action items I can own:
- Send vendor-signed NDA via DocuSign (link will be emailed to procurements@wellscopehealth.com) — target: today 7/20
- Populate the vendor onboarding form where possible and return gaps for you to fill — target: 7/21
- Confirm SSO answers that are Redwood-vendor specifics (we'll mark items that require customer detail) — target: 7/22

If procurement will accept a recorded exec demo while they process paperwork, we'll prepare a 12–15 minute executive recording focusing on:
- deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private)
- SLA & data residency options (short bullets)
- a short cost/latency example using anonymized numbers

I created a short mutual action plan doc and a poll for calendar availability: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-poll-WSH. If you want a collaborative doc I can share a Google Drive link after we agree.

CC: Marissa — can you confirm the attestation language (one-paragraph) we should propose to procurement so they can accept the security packet?

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199
From: Emily Tan <e.tan@wellscopehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurements@wellscopehealth.com, David Hsu <d.hsu@wellscopehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to pause live demo — procurement vendor onboarding + exec travel

Logan / Ben — appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement confirms they will accept:
- Vendor-signed NDA via DocuSign (please send to procurements@wellscopehealth.com)
- Redwood security packet and a one-paragraph attestation that Redwood stores no PHI unless configured and that customer-managed keys are supported (proposed attestation language is fine).
- Completed onboarding form (we'll fill the customer-specific cells after you return it).

Given David's travel, let's do this:
- Ben: send DocuSign NDA to procurement today.
- Logan / Marissa: return the onboarding form with Redwood-populated answers by end of day 7/21.
- If everything is returned by 7/23, procurement will try to approve an exec demo for the week of Aug 9. If not, procurement will push the exec demo to Aug 23–27.

Also yes — please prepare a short exec recording in the event approval slips into the later window. We prefer to see a recorded version first rather than splitting exec attention for two small sessions.

I'll confirm once the procurement inbox receives the NDA. Thanks again.

Best,
Emily
Emily Tan
Director, Product Operations | WellScope Health
procurements@wellscopehealth.com

Forwarded-For-Records: procurement copy attached
